svg.text: V-I3 — Doppler beaming asymmetry vs float64 oracle

re-shaded by the oracle (intersection → g → NT flux → Planck → XYZ → Y).
Shown: the DNGR Gargantua preset (a = 0.998), approaching side left — the [R5] convention.
